purpose: Phase-7C Section 4 adaptive input-contract configuration. Declares the fields the immutable AdaptiveImmuneContext exposes (consumed READ-ONLY from the Section-1 ImmuneFrame's innate/visibility outputs and Section-3 innate contribution when present), the validation rules, and the temporal-window constants. IMPORTANT: Section 3 (innate biology) is not implemented in this build, so innate-derived fields resolve to UNAVAILABLE (never zero); the adaptive runtime remains operational and availability-gated. Prediction-only.

validation_rules.no_zero_substitution: unavailable inputs stay UNAVAILABLE; never substituted with zero.

temporal.note: abstract simulation-frame constants only; no real-world time units; all registry-driven.

innate_availability.note: Section 3 innate biology is not implemented; innate-derived adaptive inputs are UNAVAILABLE (structurally valid, never fabricated). The adaptive runtime computes availability-gated outputs and remains fully operational when innate inputs are supplied.

coefficient_policy.valid_range: temporal constants are non-negative integer frame counts
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: temporal constants gate delayed priming/recruitment/exhaustion; they are frame counts, not real time.
